rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INCLUDE WITHIN THE COVERAGE OF THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM THOSE ELECTIVE AND APPOINTIVE OFFICIALS WHO DO NOT RECEIVE ANY BASIC PAY OR SALARY BUT WHO ARE PAID ON PER DIEMS BASIS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS TWO AND TEN OFPRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED FORTY-SIX, OTHERWISE KNOWN  AS THE REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE ACT OF 1977, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Defines the term "compensation" as the basic pay or salary received by an employee, pursuant to his employment/appo intment's, excluding per diems, bonuses, overtime pay, and allowances. NOTWITHSTANDING THIS DEFINITION OF COMPENSATION, PER DIEMS RECEIVED BY ELECTIVE OR APPOINTIVE OFFICIALS WHO DO NOT RECEIVE ANY BASIC PAY OR SALARY SHALL BE TREATED AS COMPENSATION FOR PURPOSES OF COVERAGE UNDER THIS ACT. Amends the last paragraph of Section 10 of the said Presidential Decree by including the periods of service of elective and appointive official paid on per diems basis in the computation of service for their retirement.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING SAVINGS DEPOSITS AMOUNTING TO FIFTY THOUSAND PESOS OF LESS FROM WITHHOLDING TAX, AMENDING SECTION 21(C)(1) OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE THEREBY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Small Deposits Exemption Law" States that all SAVINGS DEPOSIT in any banking or quasi-banking institutions amounting to P50,000.00 or less shall be EXEMPTED from withholding taxes which shall be enjoyed only by NATURAL PERSONS as defined by the Civil Code. Requires personbs filing their Individual Income Tax Returns to submit a Bank Certification as to the amount of their deposits. Certification reflecting P50,000.00 or less shall be required to declare the interest earned by their deposits asincome and shall be taxed accordingly.

rows.abstract: Authorizes all SSS and GSIS members to withdraw, at their option, seventy (70%) percent of their contributions on a lump sum acount equivalent to the first 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, and 40 years of their service together with their employer's share and their earned interest during the corresponding period to be used as an investment in small scale business ventures.
